name: Evaluation Engine
_comment_depends_on: Nothing here is required to START, and nothing is marked required: true.
Marking one required turns someone else's outage into ours, and this
module is the one that must not fail — a student's score cannot depend
on whether a downstream service happened to be up.
`on_missing` is shown to a human: write a sentence they can act on.
Override any base_url without editing this file: M05_BASE_URL=http://...

depends_on.name: Question Intelligence
depends_on.reason: question packages: stem, reference answer, key points, rubric binding, item parameters
depends_on.on_missing: Scoring runs against the committed fixture bank instead of the live item bank. Answers are still scored and evidence still verified; grounded items are unavailable and scores are not eligible to move ability estimates.

depends_on.name: Multimodal Analysis Suite
depends_on.reason: delivery sub-scores per turn, with the disposition that says which may be scored
depends_on.on_missing: The delivery section is omitted and says why. It is never scored as zero — a student who was not measured has not performed badly.

depends_on.name: Skill Graph & MNEMOS Memory
depends_on.reason: receives one observation per (turn, concept) from the concept-bearing dimension, and owns the re-test queue a dispute writes to
depends_on.on_missing: Observations queue to an outbox and replay with the same content-hashed id, so a replay cannot double-count. The evaluation, its evidence and the report are unaffected.

_comment_feeds: These consume M13. They are NOT dependencies - M13 never blocks on them -
but `TurnEvaluation` and the observation shape are contracts four modules
read. Additive changes are safe; renaming or removing a field breaks them.

feeds.takes: content scores and key-point coverage for the fused timeline
dimension_score ledger entries with evidence spans
